title: Utility and miscellaneous Group U buildings and other similar structures.
officialText:
Section G310 shall govern utility and
miscellaneous Group U buildings that are identified in Section 312 and other similar structures, including, but not limited to,
agricultural buildings, aircraft hangars (accessory to a one- or two-family residence), barns, grain silos (accessory to a residential
occupancy), greenhouses, livestock shelters, sheds, stables, and towers.
